SELECT count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT e.exposure_id) AS ids, count(DISTINCT e.member_key) AS keys, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.delivered THEN m.member_id END) AS delivered_members,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) THEN m.member_id END) AS in_holdout,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT m.marketing_consent THEN m.member_id END) AS noconsent_version,
 min(contact_ts_utc), max(contact_ts_utc),
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.member_key IS NULL) AS orphan
FROM fact_campaign_exposure e LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19

calls.statement:
WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.sale_date, f.channel_code, s.store_id, p.category, w.dispatch_date, f.staff_purchase_flag,
         COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS recog_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
)
SELECT 'main' AS k, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, round(sum(net_amount),2) AS net
FROM lines WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND recog_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
UNION ALL SELECT 'incl999/test', count(DISTINCT member_id), count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), round(sum(net_amount),2) FROM lines WHERE recog_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
UNION ALL SELECT 'by sale_date only', count(DISTINCT member_id), count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), round(sum(net_amount),2) FROM lines WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web lines no dispatch (cancelled/processing)', count(DISTINCT member_id), count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), round(sum(net_amount),2) FROM lines WHERE store_id=900 AND dispatch_date IS NULL AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
UNION ALL SELECT 'windowplus7', count(DISTINCT member_id), count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), round(sum(net_amount),2) FROM lines WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND recog_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
all_lines AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.category, COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS recog_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'dup receipt+line in window' AS k, count(*) AS v FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM all_lines WHERE recog_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'company net before returns', round(sum(net_amount)) FROM all_lines WHERE recog_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
UNION ALL SELECT 'control net_sales_before_returns', round(sum(net_sales_before_returns)) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
UNION ALL SELECT 'member-linked net company', round(sum(net_amount)) FROM all_lines WHERE member_key IS NOT NULL AND recog_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web lines in window', count(*) FROM all_lines WHERE store_id=900 AND recog_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'

calls.statement:
WITH campaign AS (
  SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_name = 'Spring Garden Launch 2026'
),
targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
  JOIN campaign c ON c.campaign_id = e.campaign_id
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
spend AS (
  SELECT SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_spend_before_returns
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
)
SELECT (SELECT campaign_name FROM campaign) AS campaign_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted,
       ROUND((SELECT net_spend_before_returns FROM spend), 2) AS net_spend_eur_excl_vat
